task.task_name: Verify isolated two-process offline restart and idempotency scenario
task.description: Create and run a real-network E2E test with a compiled local Go relay, a controllable loopback response-loss proxy, and two separate CLI child processes/profile directories. Fix only integration defects exposed by the test.
acceptance_criteria: Three clean E2E runs start a real Go relay with fresh on-disk Badger and two independent Node CLI child-process profiles/keys.
Both profiles mutually export/import confirmed cards and publish only through real HTTP routes before messaging.
Alice sends while Bob has no running process; Bob later polls/decrypts after restart, history contains exactly one message, and Bob replies for Alice to decrypt.

A proxy forwards a send to relay then drops the response; after sender process restart, retry with the same caller-supplied message_id reuses byte-identical serialized envelope/ciphertext and creates one receiver history entry.
A lost ack response survives receiver restart; pending ack is retried without a second decrypt/history entry.
An exact ciphertext redelivery under a new envelope_id is acknowledged without advancing native session or duplicating history; changed ciphertext under the same message_id is rejected.
Relay data/logs and all non-history CLI output contain none of the known plaintext/store-key markers.
The Go relay encodes an empty mailbox envelope collection as [] rather than null so the strict cross-language response contract remains stable.
A `test:e2e` package command is documented by package metadata and passes; prior CLI/workspace tests/typechecks and Go race suites remain green.
task.context: Write the E2E test first and record its initial RED/integration failure before any production fix. Compile apps/relay/cmd/relay once to a temp binary; run it with ECHOLET_HTTP_ADDR and ECHOLET_DATA_DIR, wait on /health, and terminate cleanly. Use a local Node proxy that forwards exact bytes/status to relay and can drop the first chosen response after relay acceptance, record send bodies, drop an ack response, and replay a captured envelope. Every CLI action must be a new Node child using dist/cli.js and environment-only 32-byte keys; never import runtime APIs for session setup. Add optional `send --message-id <uuid>` only if needed for deterministic exact retry, with normal random default preserved. A proven Go empty-mailbox `null` versus strict TypeScript array mismatch must be fixed at the repository source by returning an initialized empty slice, with a focused Go regression. Repeat the clean scenario three times. Do not commit.
task.module_patterns: Vitest process E2E, spawn/execFile with timeouts, real loopback HTTP and Go binary, isolated temporary dirs, deterministic teardown in finally/afterEach.
